prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity Simplified Chinese PeerGlide / 屏跃 desktop design proposal 03, a calm premium daily-use keyboard/mouse sharing utility.
Input image 1 is a layout reference ONLY. The user has rejected both its blue-white treatment and a subsequent forest-green/lime treatment. RETHINK the visual hierarchy and color balance; do not tint the whole interface with another hue.
Art direction: GRAPHITE + FOG + a tiny touch of WARM COPPER. Restrained, contemporary independent desktop software, precise and quiet. Warm near-white #F5F4F0 main surface; light stone #ECEBE7 sidebar, charcoal #25272B text; muted gray #62656B; soft hairlines #DCDDD8; primary CTA matte graphite #2B2D31 with warm white text. Warm copper #AE6B50 used ONLY in a tiny brand detail and a thin selected-nav indicator, less than 2% of the total interface area. No blue, green, lime, pink or purple theme. No broad colored gradients, no tinted full-width status banners, no colorful wallpapers, no glossy/glowing controls.
Navigation should be visually light, same family as the background, not a heavy dark or colored slab. A discrete selected nav row. Cards distinguished by subtle material elevation and spacing rather than thick outlines. Quiet realistic grayscale laptop/desktop illustrations with softly abstract grayscale wallpaper. Flat straight-on composition, clean Chinese sans-serif, clear typography, small 10–12px radii, generous balanced whitespace, no ornamental textures, no perspective. A polished working desktop tool, not a website or admin dashboard.
Original brand icon: small matte charcoal rounded square, two linked rounded screen outlines in warm white with a tiny warm-copper connecting bridge. Preserve the recognizable double-screen shape; do not use any other product logo.
Layout: one complete 1440x900-proportion desktop window. Left nav ~190px, main content two device cards and a clear single main action followed by a compact screen-position preview. Device details via overflow menu, not a permanent third column.
Exact Simplified Chinese text:
Brand 屏跃, small PeerGlide.
Sidebar 总览; 设备与屏幕 selected; 本机鼠标 with 预览; 剪贴板与文件 with 开发中; bottom 设置.
Heading 设备与屏幕, subtitle 一套键鼠，自在穿梭。
Header right quiet controls 停止协同 (visually disabled), 恢复本机, ＋ 添加电脑. No solid header buttons.
Tabs 设备 selected with a thin charcoal underline; 屏幕布局.
Local device card 这台 Mac, 本机 badge, 键鼠权限待检查, 输入：未开启. NO green check or ready state.
Peer card Windows 工作电脑, 已连接 · 仅通信, 键鼠尚未开启, 接收许可由对方设置, overflow dots.
Below cards a neutral, almost unboxed action area: 已连接，键鼠尚未开启; subline 先检查本机权限，再由双方分别确认。 One and only one solid GRAPHITE button 检查本机键鼠权限. Secondary quiet outline 断开连接.
Next section 屏幕位置 with link 调整布局 →. Compact grayscale outlined main-screen rectangles labelled 本机 and 工作电脑 joined with a fine neutral line. Caption 相对位置示意.
Bottom two quiet entry tiles 本机鼠标 · 窗口内预览 and 剪贴板与文件 · 尚未接通, simple outlined original icons.
Outside app frame small captions 屏跃 · 视觉提案 03 and 设备与状态为设计示例.
No account, subscription, fake latency, remote video, command terminal or extra devices. No unsupported feature shown enabled. Do not copy UU or Oink branding. All Chinese lettering crisp and readable.
